extracted.name: Diner-Style Baked Potato Home Fries
extracted.description: Tender, crisp-edged home fries start their lives as baked potatoes, either fresh-made or leftovers. That’s the secret to their texture.
ingredient_lines: salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Scrub the potatoes well and pierce with a fork. Cook on full power in microwave oven for 5 minutes; turn the potatoes over and cook 5 more minutes. Remove the potatoes from the oven and set aside to cool. Thinly slice the cooled potatoes.

Cook and stir the butter and onion in a large skillet over medium heat until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes. Gently place the potatoes into the skillet and fry, carefully flipping the potatoes a few times, until slices are browned around the edges. Sprinkle with salt and pepper.
